description: Land Acquisition - Palle Gattuwana, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Corrigenda, The Extraordinary Gaz. No. 2114/72, dated 16th March 2019, Pathahewaheta D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, including detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, their extents, boundaries, claimants, and procedural requirements for acquisition. It contains no government personnel changes, structural changes, or any elements that would fall under Types 1-3, and focuses specifically on land-related administrative matters, making it a clear Land Gazette (Type 4).
